reviews.text: Thank God for people like Dr. Toews 🙏🙏🙏.  There is absolutely no one like this amazing, kind, attentive, always professional, knowledgeable doctor! …

Firstly, I really respect and appreciate Dr. France, who was the veterinarian who saw my beloved cat last week. She was gentle and kind to both my cat and me. She earns five stars. But she's one of many veterinarians there, and I can't guarantee that others will have the same experience.

I brought my cat in at 10 PM after she vomited blood. I was hoping she had some stomach inflammation from eating something she shouldn't have. Instead, we learned that she had cancer in multiple parts of her body. Dr. France communicated these findings to me with so much care, patience, and empathy, and for that I will be forever grateful to her.

I've been to all of the area animal ERs, and I'd rank this one below BluePearl but above VERG.

Unfortunately, the rest of the experience was much less positive. When I arrived, the person at the front desk was extremely nonchalant and gave me vague instructions about where to go. I didn't realize the ER had an open setup. Every subsequent interaction with this person felt similarly detached. They seemed bored and tired, which I understand given how late it was. But they are interacting with people whose pets are sick, seriously injured, or dying, and who are often in an incredibly vulnerable state. Warmth is the bare minimum.

The triage area was also extremely loud. There needs to be some kind of sound buffering. At one point, there was a seriously wounded dog who was shrieking, and the sound reverberated off the walls. It was incredibly upsetting for my already-ill cat. The vet tech who cared for us also did not communicate what they were doing and was not particularly warm.

The cleanliness of the space was of central concern. The room we were in for approximately five hours had dog treats, fur, and small pieces of trash on the floor. More importantly, this is an animal hospital filled with sick animals, so cleanliness and infection control should be a priority. My cat walked around the room during our stay. Shortly afterward, my other indoor cat, who is immunosuppressed and had not been exposed to other animals, developed a cold. I obviously cannot know for certain where he picked up the illness, but the timing made me concerned about the hospital's cleaning and sanitizing practices, or lack thereof.

Lastly, and this is admittedly petty, but please offer something besides Cheetos and cookies for people who are spending painful hours and many thousands of dollars in your ER.

I am grateful that Dr. France treated my cat and me with compassion during an incredibly difficult night. But based on the overall experience, I would not return here unless it were absolutely necessary.

They were very kind when i brought in my dog earlier today. My dog isn’t the friendliest and they were really good with her. They also didn’t pressure me for any treatments and let me decide what i wanted to do which i appreciated  as treatments are costly. overall i feel like they really helped and they put my mind at ease during a very stressful time.

Thank you to Dr. Stever and the team for being extremely kind, communicative and comforting while our kitty, LaitLait was feeling unwell. What you do is so important, and we appreciate all that you do for our kitty and all the animals in your care!!
Everyone was amazing, from the doctor to the nurses! Amazing experience! Thank you for taking care of my baby!
I trust everyone at VEG to take care of my dog. They are so nice and good at walking you thru the most stressful of situations.

The Best Team Ever! ❤️

Dr. Macy Russell is truly exceptional. She is experienced, honest, compassionate, and genuinely dedicated to helping animals. I never feel like she is trying to recommend unnecessary treatments just to make money—her priority is always the well-being of the animal.

Dr. Russell has helped my cat, Mio, twice, and both times her diagnosis was accurate and her care was excellent. I tend to get very nervous when Mio is not feeling well, but Dr. Russell always takes the time to reassure me, explain what is happening, and make me feel more at ease. I have complete trust in her judgment and the care she provides.

The veterinary assistants are also wonderful. Alexia was incredibly helpful and caring, there is also a guy that has been working there for a long time i believe he is an assistant also he is amazing and has helped me before and I truly appreciate the entire team.

I would gladly return here again and again if Mio ever needs care. Thank you to Dr. Russell, Alexia, and the entire team for always taking such great care of Mio when he needs you. ❤️🐾

Highly recommended!

Just needed to update my review from previous. I’ve had very mixed experiences here.  One where they didn’t sedate my cat enough and they let her wake up mid operation and run off the operating table with wires attached to her. Other times where the doctors and staff were just incredibly dismissive. I needed some emergency syringes for my diabetic cat bc I had just run out, and they charged $30 for 10 singular syringes saying it’s “market price”. Market price for 100 syringes goes for about $20. Absolutely ridiculous and taking advantage of those who are in need.

UPDATE 6/4/2026 a month later my dog was sick again and I went to another vet office and that vet was highly unprofessional and negligent. i called VEG and they helped me out right away. thank you Dr Madill She was great!
4/29/2026: i arrived in distress and i was greeted and made feel welcome and safe with my animal companion. Nicole F , Samantha
and Dr Alvaraz  were great and hospitable. i'm very grateful. 🐈‍⬛🙏

They are literally the best I took my cat in because he wouldn’t stop vomiting and barely a day later he’s back to himself everyone there is so sweet the doctor nurses all the staff the place itself is just so clean and great place to take your pet we didn’t wait long at all either 🥰 …
Worked with budget

ALWAYS MAKE SURE TO COME TO THE BROOKLYN LOCATION HERE! It's the best location because it has extremely professional and kind staff. My cat was extremely sick and vomiting for days; we came here for ER care since he needed medicine, X-rays, and bloodwork. The technicians and doctors were amazing with my cat, given that my cat is an extremely aggressive orange cat. I would come here only for emergency visits, unlike other places that are hostile and aggressive toward animals.
Excellent service and care
Outstanding!
They saved my senior dog, Monty. Cannot thank them enough for their service and compassionate care during an extremely stressful time of medical distress.

I Just want to give a special thanks to- Trinity . Your transparency and proficiency in the process couldn’t ask for a better nurse. I was waiting with my wife for 4 hours in a room which was freezing for her fair for me .My wife is anemic Trinity checked on our dog and immediately asked my wife if she needed a blanket 5 seconds after she Came in the room and wrapped it around her our hearts got stolen . Need that compassion in human hospital. Above and beyond . Truly and to all the staff at VEG thank you. Me and my wife typically never have a good experience at the vet with our dog. This experience was warm and homey .

Came in for my Cat that had accidently de-gloved the tip of his tail.  Was extremely scared about going to a veterinary ER as I have heard the horror stories.  But when we got in there at 630am.  Everyone was super helpful and kind.  Sam was our nurse and she couldn't have been more understanding with the diagnoses.  The solution was to amputate the tip of the tail and this is a simple but expensive procedure.  Started out at 3500.  Her and Dr. France gave us time to talk over options and even call other vets to see if there were any places that could do the operation cheaper.  In the end though all other vets were sending in estimates of the same price range.  And when we finally spoke to them about dropping the price they ended up working with us to get it down about 800 bux.  This was so kind of them.  The whole staff was friendly and ready to help and answer any questions.

The surgery was quick and Riku was out of there within 2 hours after the papers were signed.  Thank you so much guys at VEG ER.  Hopefully we do not have to see you again too.soon but if there is ever another Cat emergency we know where we are going.

Ryan Reynolds
Excellent service. Took my dog for an emergency visit in the ealry morning and they were quick, thorough and friendly. Thank you for taking care of my dog.

I brought in my pet on a holiday and even though it was busy the staff did a great job at handling the amount of animals and families! I was really pleased with their attentiveness and kindness! I felt comfortable leaving my pet in their care and trusted they were doing right by us

came in at 11PM and stayed overnight with an emergency for my old cat, they took her in in a beat and expressed nothing but patience, kindness, compassion, and expertise the entire night. echoing what others have said re: transparency about what was happening, care plan, pricing, timing, expectations, etc. huge shoutout to the thursday-friday overnight team and dr. donohue, eric, and jafet for taking such good care of my girl! so glad to have chosen the right place. they no doubt saved her life.

I cannot thank Dr. Turturo enough for saving my cat’s life from what ended up being an extremely serious condition— large linear obstruction with significant intestinal plication.

I had brought him the previous day to a primary care vet who took his blood and an X-Ray and had dismissed his life-threatening symptoms as “stress”.

Dr. Turturo listened to me so diligently. She could’ve charged me more by re-ordering an X-Ray and bloodwork, but didn’t, because she had the competence to understand that it would be futile and the compassion to save me the unnecessary charges.

The clinic was short-staffed that day and their on-call ultrasound techs were not available, but she called around everywhere to get someone in to do his ultrasound, and then continued calling around to find a surgeon who could operate on him ASAP.

She was so patient and kind and articulate in the way she explained everything to me — what they were going to do and why they were going to do it, what his ultrasound indicated, the risks, etc. I absolutely cannot thank her and the rest of the staff enough!

The clinic is also VERY nice, clean, and welll-organized, with several private rooms. Front desk staff, vet techs, really everyone involved was extremely kind and easygoing. Highly recommend for your per emergencies!!

The service here is truly one of a kind everyone is extremely kind and there love for animals really shows through every step of the way. The nurse jayden was so kind and understanding and was able to translate everything for me and my mom. The doctor Cale Toews was also pacient and kind. I am so thankful for this er and i would’nt choose to go to any other. Thank you so much

I was given a thorough rundown of what was wrong with my cat, the possible causes, and what they could do to treat the issue. I never felt pressured into any treatment options and they answered all my questions. All the staff was very kind and friendly! I've had to visit a few times in the past as well and I would take my cats again if there's ever another issue.
At 8 o'clock on a rainy night, the staff were kind, considerate, and straightforward with me about my cat Henry's condition. They saw me through one of life's worst moments with plenty of grace.
Great crew! The front desk, nurses and doctors. Dr. Jones and dr. Turturro were so amazing. This organization is attentive, genuinely caring even under high pressure situations.

I came in on a Sunday because my cat was constipated and distressed. They took very good care of both me and him. Even though they were busy we didn't feel rushed, which was so appreciated considering a lot of time was spent waiting for him to poop. They were very upfront about their pricing (thankfully I have pet insurance) and knowledgable about what was going on in his intestines. The next day he was lethargic so I brought him back, where we received the same level of attention. They did bloodwork just to be safe, which is when I discovered that if you bring your pet back in within 24 hours, they waive the emergency appointment fee! I was grateful they took the extra step, because as it turns out his kidney levels were elevated, something my normal vet either didn't catch or didn't alert me to. They went over medications and long term care, advised on a new food, put in the scripts for me, gave him fluids, and sent us home with more knowledge about his health than we had going in.

Updated review: edit: I have a medium sized dog, and he needed emergency care this past week when his typically energetic self refused to leave his crate for a walk. I just rescued him around two weeks ago! They ran a ton of tests, including imaging, and it turned out that he needed an endoscopy, during which Dr Blake Jones removed multiple scraps of a toy (genuinely the entire face of one of them). He recovered quickly and came home! It was a long 30 hours but he was in great hands there! It’s always scary to need medical care for pets but they made me feel very secure to leave him there overnight. He also loved the staff members and led me straight to his kennel after I took him for a potty break prior to discharge! Another very positive experience at this hospital!

I had a really positive experience with the VEG team this evening with my cat. They care deeply and pay close attention each patient, giving them the time they need. I felt like my concerns were addressed with solid advice and treatment, and I would recommend them!
a place that will make you feel safe. Dr Ramos and the entire team are exceptional.

Kind staff, but dangerously understaffed with unacceptable communication

I brought my senior dog here because he suddenly became extremely bloated and was breathing rapidly and shallowly. I was terrified that he could stop breathing, yet we waited more than 4.5 hours before being seen.

What made the experience even more upsetting was seeing and hearing members of the medical staff chatting and laughing while I sat nearby in obvious distress, terrified for my dog and receiving almost no information. I understand that hospital employees are human and may have brief moments between emergencies, but from a frightened pet owner’s perspective, the lack of urgency and communication felt incredibly dismissive.

When my dog was finally evaluated, they performed an ultrasound and recommended spinal surgery, an examination by a stomach specialist and potentially additional surgery. Before we could complete a treatment plan, the veterinarian left to treat another dog who appeared to be in more critical condition.

I completely understand triage and agree that the most critical patient must be treated first. The unacceptable part was being told that only one veterinarian was covering the emergency hospital and that no one could give me any estimate of when my dog’s care would continue. By then it was approximately 5:30 a.m., and we had been there through the night. I eventually left to monitor him myself until his regular veterinarian opened.

I am giving two stars because several staff members were personally kind. However, kindness does not make up for an NYC emergency hospital being so understaffed that it seemingly cannot manage more than one serious case at a time. If adequate emergency care cannot be provided promptly, families should be told immediately so they can seek treatment elsewhere instead of losing critical hours waiting without information.
Very efficient and pleasant experience
Wish I could say good things but I waited over three hours to never have my dog seen because other dogs took priority over mine.

Exceptional-the team here is beyond any vet ER experience I have ever had. Highly knowledgeable, fast acting for an emergency scenario, compassionate, intuitive(for both pets and their owners) all hands on deck including the front desk staffed who raced to support us-you can rest assured your pet is in great hands! Dr. Madill and the entire team never missed a beat, Williamsburg is lucky to have them.
Unbelievably great service, every single staff member was 10/10, really helpful, even though me and my dog came on a busy night, the efficiency this ER team has is top notch. cannot recommend enough.
Took amazing care of my coco and the doctors were so compassionate and supportive. I love it.

I always go to one in Manhattan and my pet was taken care of so well, stuff is soo nice. I was in Brooklyn when my dog had emergency. Wasted a whole hour waiting to find out Dr. Wasn’t even there yet. My dog was in pain. There was bunch of people just sitting without being seen for so long, there were people who came before me. No one seem to have an update. If you have emergency situation this is not a place!

We spent approximately $4,000 at VEG Brooklyn and left without a clear or workable treatment plan for our cat.
We were initially told that X-rays were necessary, only to then be told that she also needed a significantly more expensive ultrasound. After completing both, we were advised that the next step was to see a specialist, which could bring the total cost of her care to more than $10,000. Although we were told that the likely possibilities included IBD or lymphoma, a steroid trial was never discussed, and we were sent home without meaningful treatment to manage her symptoms.
While I understand that veterinary technicians have an important role and were doing what they were instructed to do, conversations involving a potential bill of more than $10,000 should include direct, thoughtful communication from the veterinarian. The financial discussions lacked the care, clarity, and sensitivity that a decision of this magnitude required. Staff also repeatedly misgendered our cat, which may seem minor, but further contributed to the impression that her case was not being handled with adequate attention or care.
Because our cat remained unwell, we had to take her to another emergency hospital, incur additional expenses, and continue searching for a veterinarian who would listen carefully to our concerns (which, mind you, this next ER worked with us on different financial options and pushed to have our pet feel comfort at home).
The final veterinarian we saw charged approximately $500 - a fraction of what we paid at VEG - and was shocked that a steroid had not even been discussed, particularly after IBD or lymphoma had been presented as the likely diagnoses. That veterinarian carefully reviewed the options with us and prescribed a steroid to treat her suspected underlying condition.
I understand that veterinary medicine can be complicated and that diagnostic testing is sometimes necessary. However, after spending $4,000, we expected clear communication, consideration of our financial limitations, and a meaningful plan for keeping our cat comfortable and treating her symptoms. Instead, we left with an enormous bill, no relief for our cat, and the message that we would need to spend thousands more before anything could be done.
It was deeply upsetting to later learn that a significantly more affordable treatment option could - and, according to the veterinarian who ultimately helped us, should - have at least been discussed. The lack of direct veterinary communication, thoughtful financial counseling, and attention to basic details was unacceptable and unprofessional.
Do not bring your precious animals here. Go to VERG in Brooklyn, as they are not as money hungry, and will take the time to talk through options with you.

*Only giving a 2 instead of a 1, because I appreciate the Veterinarians at VEG and wish they could get paid more.
